content.title: Nampa Craftsman
content.lead: Original character, a refreshed kitchen and a backyard with real room to play.
paragraphs: A covered front porch, original millwork and a bright updated kitchen give this Nampa craftsman plenty of personality.
Three bedrooms and two baths on a generous lot make it a strong first home or a smart investment with room to add value.
